asr_text: Long silences on your voice agent calls, here's how they're billed. Voice only calls are charged based on call duration, but silence longer than 10 seconds gets a 95 % discount. Those periods are billed at 5 % of the usual per minute rate. The catch billing follows the connection until the call ends or window closes. Rates change so always check the official pricing page.
